race.title: Guaranteed Odds At David Lucas Bookmakers Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
race.verdict: SEA THE DAY impressed with his attitude when seeing off a point winner in a C&D bumper on his debut last November before finishing mid-field in a strong race at Ascot, and rates another fine hurdling prospect for his top yard. Common Sense showed plenty under an enterprising ride on his first start over hurdles at Ffos Las recently and is sure to pose a big threat if brushing up his jumping, while Herbies Sock and Passage Guenot are others to consider. SEA THE DAY (IRE) COMMON SENSE (IRE) HERBIES SOCK (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Sea The Day (11/4), Common Sense (4/1), What's Your Game (6/1), Passage Guenot (6/1), Herbies Sock (13/2), Sears Crossing (10/1), Littlebobbydazzler (12/1), Debrave Soldier (12/1), Beau Merle (25/1), Barrow Hill Lad (33/1), Clonagoose (33/1), Commander King (33/1), Lingering Glance (33/1), The Sky At Night (100/1)
